hard_invariants: Every rule must name one author_id, one work_id, one language, one textual_lineage, and one passage address.
The Great Introduction and its Abbreviation are different works and may not inherit rules from one another.
Hermann of Carinthia and John of Seville are separate Latin translation lineages; agreement may be recorded but never presumed.
A Latin witness cannot establish Abu Ma'shar's or al-Qabisi's Arabic wording without alignment to the Arabic witness.
The Wurzburg TEI files inspected do not include the modern English translations or full critical apparatus.
Cross-author comparison is an explicitly labeled research view, never a generic Islamicate doctrine pack.
No artifact in this matrix is eligible for the live Western engine or for customer-facing output.
